evidence.title: Beyond What Meets the Eye: Unveiling Situational Illusions for Multimodal Large Language Models

summary: A new study exposes vulnerabilities in multimodal large language models, demonstrating how they can be misled by situational illusions. The findings highlight the need for improved robustness in AI systems processing visual and textual inputs.
title: Researchers Unveil Situational Illusions Affecting Multimodal AI Models
